name: GSK1360707F
summary: GSK1360707F is a potent and selective triple reuptake inhibitor. It is chemically related to amitifadine and NS-2359 (GSK-372,475). Until recently, it was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder; its development was put on hold for strategic reasons.

pharmacology.text: GSK1360707F is a potent and selective triple reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Until recently, it was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder; its development was put on hold for strategic reasons.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that block these three transporters can cause trouble sleeping, nausea, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and may carry a risk of misuse.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。阻斷這三種轉運蛋白的藥物可能造成失眠、噁心、心跳與血壓上升，也可能有被濫用的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。阻断这三种转运蛋白的药物可能造成失眠、恶心、心跳与血压上升，也可能有被滥用的风险。

fact.en: It belongs to a group called triple reuptake inhibitors, designed to slow the clearing of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine all at once, in the hope of treating more symptoms of depression than older antidepressants.
fact.zh: 它屬於所謂的三重再回收抑制劑，被設計成同時減緩血清素、正腎上腺素和多巴胺的清除，希望比舊式抗憂鬱藥改善更多憂鬱症狀。
fact.zhHans: 它属于所谓的三重再回收抑制剂，被设计成同时减缓血清素、正肾上腺素和多巴胺的清除，希望比旧式抗忧郁药改善更多忧郁症状。
